What is changing

HMRC is helping insolvency practitioners by streamlining the way we deal with insolvency in relation to the Economic Crime Levy.

We have now introduced an online form which must be used to:

submit Economic Crime Levy returns

cancel a registration for the Economic Crime Levy

What we need you to do

We have created section 28 in the insolvency practitioner’s handbook. It includes a link to guidance about when an entity liable for the Economic Crime Levy has become insolvent.

Make sure you use the correct details on the form so that we can deal with your correspondence as quickly as possible.

Further questions

If you have any questions about this insolvency bulletin, contact R3 or your representative group, who will take them forward with us.
